app.title: QuestLog
app.noProject: No projects found. Push todos from a project directory via Claude.

kanban.ackNightlyTitle: Confirm the nightly result is good and move it into the regular done area

card.autoToggleTitle: Toggle: allow the collector to auto-run this read-only research todo in the nightly window (03:00–06:00) and write back the result

epic.emptyDesc: Track parallel plans across conversations with dependency links.
epic.cmdCtrlMultiSelect: Hold Cmd/Ctrl to multi-select dependency plans
epic.titlePlaceholder: Plan title (title only; priority from dropdown below)
epic.stepDepsTitle: Cmd/Ctrl multi-select: this step waits for the selected steps
epic.acceptancePlaceholder: Acceptance criteria (optional, e.g. "all steps observed + 3 days stable in prod")
epic.closeReasonPlaceholder: Required when closing before 100% (e.g. "direction changed, merged into plan B")
epic.archivedHint: Done plans are auto-archived; set status back to restore

arb.title: Arb Opportunities
arb.offDesc: Enable it in Settings (top-right) and point it at the GROS board.json export
arb.emptyTitle: Arb board off or no data
arb.emptyMissing:
Board file not found: {{path}}
Run gros board-export in the project directory
arb.toggleHint: Enable/disable the arb board for this project
arb.pathHint: board.json path (relative to project root, e.g. gros/exports/board.json)
arb.leadsHint: leads ≠ hypotheses · promote via review flow
arb.leadToResearchHint: Copy research prompt → paste into a GROS session (promote via review flow, no direct write)

execution.title: Execution
execution.epicAutoOff: This epic is blocked from auto-execution
execution.decisionRecordedHint: An answer records the decision but does not restart work; retry explicitly, or revise and reseal.
execution.runnerStatusHint: Runner heartbeat: every poll (even idle) updates it. Green = polling; yellow = on but no successful poll recently; gray = not running.
execution.runnerStatusSealedHint: Sealed packages waiting for pickup: once the project switch is ON and the epic has an explicit ▶, the Runner claims them on its next poll.
execution.modelSelectorHint: Model used by Runner auto-execution (read from ZCode config, injected into worktree project config)
execution.thinkingSelectorHint: Thinking is selected independently of the model; the level list follows your ZCode config (reasoning.variants/levels) automatically. When set, the chosen level's params are normalized across all levels in the worktree, unaffected by the CLI's global thinking setting.
execution.globalOnTitle: Runner master switch is ON (click to emergency-stop all auto-claiming)
execution.globalOffTitle: Runner master switch is OFF (emergency stop active: project switches have no effect)
execution.projectBlockedByGlobal: Project is ON, but the master switch (⏻) is OFF — nothing will run
execution.budgetExhausted: exhausted — revise the sealed package to retry
execution.budgetExhaustedHint: Auto-retry budget exhausted — revise the sealed package (prepare → validate → seal) to continue
execution.blockedByGlobalFirst: Plan authorized, but the master switch (emergency stop) is OFF — turn it on to auto-execute
execution.blockedByProjectFirst: Plan authorized, but the project trust (one-time setting) is OFF — enable the project switch to auto-execute

protocol.actionableNone: No actionable steps (waiting for dependencies or plan done)

drq.retryExhausted: The attempt budget is exhausted. Inspect evidence, revise the package, or cancel.
drq.gitDrift: Git base changed after the package was sealed. Revise and reseal, or cancel.
drq.verifierFailed: The exact candidate failed acceptance. Inspect evidence: retry, revise, or cancel.
drq.approval: Execution was paused or needs authorization. Resume, revise the package, or cancel?
drq.adjudication: Two valid paths — human adjudication required.
drq.scopePath: The candidate changed paths outside the sealed scope. The full scene is captured in the bundle's scene/; a revised package's first attempt auto-restores it (same base only). Revise scope or cancel?
drq.scopeForbiddenOrCount: The candidate touched a forbidden/control-plane path or exceeded the last-resort file-count breaker — no scope revision can fix this. Revise the package (drop the goal or raise max) or cancel.
